libert_stock.scope: One 192-token-cap wave per shape; separate from the three-repetition 384-token throughput campaign.

mia_stock.scope: One 192-token-cap wave per shape; separate from the three-repetition 384-token throughput campaign.

mia_keys.scope: One 192-token-cap wave per shape; separate from the three-repetition 384-token throughput campaign.

stock.deep_request_scope: Single synthetic cold requests interleaved with stability traffic; not a repeated or matched deep-context benchmark campaign.
stock.limits: Bounded 1.0-hour diagnostic; not a full release-endurance or long-term leak-freedom claim.

keys.deep_request_scope: Single synthetic cold requests interleaved with stability traffic; not a repeated or matched deep-context benchmark campaign.
keys.limits: Bounded 0.5-hour diagnostic; not a full release-endurance or long-term leak-freedom claim.

switching.failure_recovery_scope: Controller tests cover fallback/refusals; successful switches were rehearsed on hardware.

lan_serving.scope: Small synthetic startup checks on the newly launched LAN pair; not a repeat of capacity or endurance qualification.

acceptance_findings: Both variants passed all 21 finite gates, two full-window C32 waves with exact replay, and cold million-token retrieval of all three passphrases. Capacity and guards were unchanged.

Fresh matched stock throughput: all six C32 medians improved 0.10–2.57%; C1 ranged from -6.22% for sampled code to +11.37% for sampled prose. All repetitions were retained. Changed weights and draft acceptance limit causal interpretation.
Matching Keys throughput versus Mia stock: C32 -2.30% to +5.73%, C1 -5.85% to -0.34%. The optional variant remains comparable and is not selected for final serving.

Stock GPU weight allocation is 106110129620 bytes per rank, 79.96875 MiB less than the old stock runtime. Both ranks independently reported zero additional weight bytes with matching K5 Keys and the intended 0/78 replacement entries.

One-hour stock and half-hour Keys diagnostics completed 1379 and 1085 requests. Normalized anonymous-plus-swap growth was +2.285/+2.152 MiB for stock and +2.566/+2.031 MiB for Keys. No observed OOM, poison/RDMA, probe, watchdog or shape/graph violations occurred.

Whole-run sampled available-RAM minima were stock 2.589/2.183 GiB and Keys 2.706/3.724 GiB. The unchanged 2 GiB guard remains close enough to the stock worker minimum to retain existing protections and avoid expanding capacity.

Monitor-history limitation: the earliest approximately 35 stock minutes retain minute-series observations after high-resolution rotation. Later stock and all Keys retain roughly five-second samples. Actual gaps and immutable preserved-file hashes are recorded; sampled minima are not continuous minima.

The stock/Keys/stock/Keys/stock rehearsal passed six seeded prompts per stage, identical replay within each variant including final stock, unchanged aliases and base-cache identities. Five of six replies differed between variants; this is not a refusal-rate or quality evaluation.

Old source, images, installation journals, prepared caches and verified head-side original bytes remain retained. Original worker source restoration requires approximately 315.6 GB of verified copy-back; full copy-back has not been rehearsed.
Evidence supports stock Mia LAN cutover with optional Keys prepared. These bounded observations are not a 12/24-hour endurance or general model-quality qualification.

complete_validation_memory.scope: Deduplicated preserved high-resolution rotations and minute-series observations from each workload campaign through its finite gates and bounded diagnostic; no new requests.
limitations: The earliest stock high-resolution files rotated out before this review; the retained minute series covers that period. Per-variant sampling coverage is recorded explicitly.

Memory minima and error counts summarize preserved observations, not a continuously measured minimum or proof that no shorter transient occurred. The separate diagnostic memory analyses retain their complete observation series.

publication_checks.scope: Final source/configuration, synthetic controller clients, documentation and publication checks; hardware and LAN evidence is recorded separately.
publication_checks.environment_note: Loopback-dependent tests were rerun outside the restricted sandbox after socket creation was denied; no test or runtime changes were needed.

limitations: Finite functional and capacity checks do not establish a general quantization quality ranking or refusal-rate change.
One-hour stock and half-hour Keys diagnostics are bounded observations, not long-duration endurance qualification.
Full-context C32 uses a primed shared document with independent active reservations, not 32 unique cold prefills.
Changed weights can change replies, early stopping and draft acceptance; matched throughput is not an isolated kernel comparison.
The entire original worker restoration has not been rehearsed; its exact-file verified backups and recovery procedure are retained.
